summary: This clinical study compared two drugs, dapagliflozin and empagliflozin, to see how they affect nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) in patients with type 2 diabetes. The study looked at adults aged 18 to 65 years old who took the medications along with metformin. Researchers checked participants using liver scans and blood tests over a period of six months. NCT07363707
